desc.en: This Qunoot has been mentioned by Syed bin Taoos in his book Muhaj-ud-Daawaat and by Kaf’ami in Al Balad-ul-Amin, both narrating from Imam Reza (a)…
desc.rurdu: Yeh Qunoot Syed ibne Taoos ne apni kitaab Muhaj-ud-Daawaat aur Kaf’ami Baladul Amin mein Imam Reza (a) se riwaayat ki hai…
desc.urdu: یہ قنوت سید ابن طاؤس نے کتاب مهج الدعوات اور کعفمی نے کتاب البلد الأمين امام علی رضاؑ سے روایت کی ہے۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلْفَزَعُ الْفَزَعُ اِلَیْكَ یَا ذَاالْمُحَاضَرَۃِ، وَالرَّغْبَۃُ الرَّغْبَۃُ اِلَیْكَ یَا مَنْ بِهِ الْفَاخَرَۃُ، وَاَنْتَ اللّٰهُمَّ مَشَاهِدُ هَوَاجِسِ النُّفُوْسِ، وَمُرَاصِدُ حَعَكَاتِ الْقُلُوْبِ، وَمُطَالِعُ مَسَرَّاتِ السَّرَائِرِ مِنْ غَیْرِ تَكَلُّفٍ لَا تَعَسُّفٍ، وَقَدْ تَرَی اللّٰهُمَّ مَا لَیْسَ عَنْكَ بِمُنْطَوْیٍ، وَلٰكِنَّ حِلْمِكَ آمَنَ اَهْلَهٗ عَلَیْهِ جُرْئَۃً وَتَمَرُّدًا وَعُتُوَّا وَعِنَادًا۔

trans.en: Refuge, Refuge; towards You O He before whom all are present; eagerness, eagerness, for the Lord who alone deserves all pride, and You O Allah are witness to all the mental occurring of souls, and are watchful of the cardiac movements of human beings, and are aware of the hidden matters without any difficulty and hardship, and You O Allah certainly sight all that has not deviated from You, but Your forbearance and endurance has secured those men who committed such wrongdoings, which resulted in further daring, mischief, obstinacy and enmity.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: وَمَا یُعَانِیْهِ اَوْلِیَاؤُكَ مِنْ تَعْفِیَۃِ آثَارِ الْحَقِّ، وَدُرُوْسِ مَعَالِمِهٖ، وَتَزَیُّدِ الْفَوَاحِشِ، وَاسْتِمْرَارِ اَهْلِهَا عَلَیْهَا، وَظُهُوْرِ الْبَاطِلِ وَعُمُوْمِ التَّغَاشُمِ، وَالتَّرَاضِیْ، بِذٰلِكَ فِیْ الْمُعَامِلَاتِ وَالْمُتَصَرَّفَاتِ مُذْجَرَتْ بِهِ الْعَادَاتُ، وَصَارَ كَالْمَفْرُوْضَاتِ وَالْمَسْنُوْنَاتِ۔

trans.en: And You certainly see the hardships faced by Your friends due to the destruction of the impressions of truth and the vanishing of its signs, and the increase in obscenity and indecency, and the ongoing corruptions by the wrongdoers, and the manifestation of evil and dishonesty, and the domination of oppression and cruelty, and the satisfaction of both sides upon the transactional transgression and tyranny and habitual acts which have become similar to the obligations and recommendations.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَبَادِرِ الَّذِیْ مَنْ اَعَنْتَهٗ بِهٖ فَازَ، وَمَنْ اَیَّدْتَهٗ لَمْ یَخَفْ لَمْزَ لَمَّازِ، وَخُذِ الظَّالِمَ اَخْذًا عَنِیْفًا، وَلَا تَكُنْ لَهٗ رَاحِمًا وَلَا بِهٖ رَؤُوْفًا۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اللّٰهُمَّ اللّٰهُمَّ بَادِرْهُمْ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ عَاجِلْهُمْ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تُمْهِلْهُمْ۔

trans.en: O Allah, help me soon with the assistance which ensures the salvation of the assisted, and whoever attains success with Your help does not fear the blame of any blamer, entangle the transgressors severely, and do not have any mercy on them. O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, show haste. O Allah, show haste (in their case). O Allah, do not give them respite.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ غَادِرْهُمْ بُكْرَۃً وَهَجِیْرَۃً وَسُحْرَۃً وَبَیَاتًا وَهُمْ نَائِمُوْنَ، وَضُحْیً وَهُمْ یَلْعَبُوْنَ، وَمَكْرًا وَهُمْ یَمْكُرُوْنَ، وَفُجْاَۃً وَهُمْ آمِنُوْنَ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ بَدِّدْهُمْ، وَبَدِّدْ اَعْوَانَهُمْ، اَافْلُلْ اَعْضَادَهُمْ، وَاهْزِمْ جُنُوْدَهُمْ، وَافْلُلْ حَدَّهُمْ، وَاجْتَتَّ سَنَامَهُمْ، وَاَضْعِفْ عَزَائِمَهُمْ۔

trans.en: O Allah, capture them at dawn, in the middle of the day, and at night while they are sleeping, and in the daytime while they are engaged and busy, and deceive them, and scheme against them while they scheme, and capture them immediately while they find themselves relieved, O Allah, scatter them and those who aid them, and defeat their partners and elude their warriors, and make their sharp swords blunt, destroy their chiefs, and weaken their strong determinations.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ امْنَحْنَا اَكْتَافَهُمْ، وَمَلِّكْنَا اَكْنَافَهُمْ، وَبَدِّلْهُمْ بِالنِّعَمِ النِّقَمَ، وَبَدِّلْنَا مِنْ مُحَاذَرَتِهِمْ وَبَغْیِهِمُ السَّلَامَۃَ، وَاغْنِمْنَاهُمْ اَكْمَلَ الْمَغْنَمِ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تَرُدَّ عَنْهُمْ بَاسَكَ الَّذِیْ اِذَا حَلَّ بِقَوْمٍ فَسَائَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِیْنَ۔

trans.en: O Allah, be gracious upon us and enslave them for us, and bring their lands under our possession, and turn their fortunes into misfortunes, and replace our fear and their oppression with peace and safety for us, and gives us the most complete spoils of war from them. O Allah, do not withdraw Your torment and punishment from them, the punishment which brings disgrace and adversity to the punished.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
